description.value: North Beach Campground is one of three large campgrounds in Golden Ears Park, a major provincial destination about an hour east of Vancouver with Alouette Lake swimming, paddling rentals, and an extensive hiking trail network. It draws big summer crowds and has no cell service on site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a 54-site campground in Golden Ears Provincial Park with tents and caravans allowed, open fires permitted, and a sanitary dump station. The BC Parks website confirms Golden Ears has three large campgrounds and is one of BC's most popular camping destinations, with a prominent 'Book camping' link indicating reservations are accepted. The website notes no cell phone service at campgrounds. Most specific amenity details (showers, potable water, food storage) are not mentioned on the fetched page, so those remain null.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established 54-site provincial park campground in one of BC's most popular parks, easily accessible from Vancouver — strong fit for touring cyclists on Lower Mainland routes.
